spans.s: मुग्धबोध lit. instructions to the ignorant: a treatise on grammar similar to the Astaadhyayi of Paanini but much shorter, written by Bopadeva or Vopadeva an inhabitant of the greater Mahaaraastra in the Vardhaa district, in the thirteenth century. After the fall of the Hindu rulers in Bengal, treatises like भाषावृत्ति and others written by eastern grammarians fell into the back-ground and their place was taken up by easier treatises written by Bopadeva and others. Many commentaries were written upon the Mugdhabodha, of which the Vidyaanivsaa is much known to grammarians

मुग्धबोधटीका a commentary work on Mugdhabodha;the name is given to commentaries written by Raamatarkavaagisa (called मुग्धबोधपरिशिष्ट }, by Raadhaavallabha (called सुबोधिनी), . by Gangaadhara (called सेतुसेग्रह ), by Durgaadaasa, by Dayaaraama and by Raamaananda.
